body:
TermAl Merger operating procedure, recovered 2026-10-25 by replacement Merger2. Sources: TermAl memory greg-decision-2026-10-24-checkin-rule rev1 (Greg's direct words in Architect1/session-8982: "dokladnie tak / testy przeszly, review jest OK check-in / nawet nie wiem co to jest kredyt hosta ? co to jest ? / ewaluacje musimy zatrzymac bo nie robimy postepu"); termal-emergency-stop-2026-10-24 rev60 (#1762 workflow and later #72 merge-queue-only resumption); termal-greg-merger-role-rule-2026-10-19 rev1; termal-build-cap-policy rev13. Engram::Architect3's onboarding message mailbox-message-7783f9da-93f2-4709-9bf7-6a50959e313c relays Greg's request to onboard the replacement and supplies operational recommendations, not additional landing authority.

Procedure: coder implements, runs relevant/new tests, freezes the package and completes the required independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium or higher. Package names task/scope, coder, base, root, patch/staged blobs and fingerprint kind, focused results and complete review outputs/finding disposition. Merger reads the full review outputs and integrates that existing package on the current authorized master base. Conflicts or product/test/fixture/doc fixes return to the owning coder, including one-line fixes; coder supplies the repaired, appropriately reviewed package. No second review on the Merger side. No acceptance evaluations; no host-credit prerequisite. When the exact final tree's maintained full launcher gate is green and the existing required review is clean, proceed to the authorized check-in/landing without waiting for those excluded conditions. Preserve the assigned integration owner's push/install boundary, remote-base and fast-forward checks; memory creates no replacement push authority. No amend/rebase/force-push. Verify remote containment and exact-tree installed build when installation is authorized; Greg performs host restarts.

Operational recommendations (Architect3, supported by existing TermAl runner/dependency records): ensure exclusive source-root use before acting; check launcher prerequisites and lockfile, own worktree ui/node_modules (npm ci in ui), TypeScript/Vitest, tools and disk before assigning the gate. Do not invent a new preflight/global toolchain. One full gate host-wide (termal-build-cap-policy rev13); ordinary independent builds/focused checks do not require gate synchronization. Freeze the final tree, run the standard launcher once, or recover an existing run for that same input. Gate truth is request/results, all required stages, terminal state/exit and matching expected/before/after fingerprints. PID/STARTED, promises or credit are not PASS. Failed/unrun is not a product-test pass; missing result is UNKNOWN: diagnose that existing run with summary/recover as documented, never an automatic retry loop. A changed final tree needs a new gate. Preserve evidence; do not kill processes or remove another lane's roots.

Waits name exact dependency/run, owner, next action, result sender, absolute check time and recovery owner/GAP. Notes do not register timers or grant automation. Re-read actual run results before saying a gate is still running. A credit/named-root 409 is a recording incident, not a reinstated merge prerequisite; actual authorization refusals must be reported and respected.

Supersession: for this workflow the evaluation/host-credit/per-item repeat-gate and extra Merger review requirements in termal-merger-model-2026-10-10 rev11, merger-freeze-crlf-rules rev6 section8, landing-integration-and-install rev6 and rules-waits-and-wakes rev4 are historical and superseded in that specific scope by Greg's 2026-10-24 decisions above. Nonconflicting ownership, source integrity, safety, exact-tree tests, review and push/install rules remain. History is retained; this record changes no repository instructions or authority.

Current authorization must be read separately from this procedure. Latest replacement-specific handoff: Advisor mailbox-message-cf4df403-3805-4308-bc8f-f4ca16f5398f (2026-10-25T03:27:12Z) says preserve state, no merge/carry/gate/evaluation/resume until onboarding and a new instruction. Its authoritative base is 00a4ecea; local stash changes are excluded from candidates. Do not import the Engram project's queue as TermAl work. Observed via host /api/state on 2026-10-25 around03:28Z: TermAl project-6 Engram enabled=true, turnGatedControl=false; this is an observation, not permission to change configuration. Queue and run state belong in integration task STATUS/NOTES, not global rule revisions.
